tree.text: “NOAA” means the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration within the Department of Commerce.
“NOAA fleet” means the fleet of research vessels owned or operated by NOAA.
“Plan” means the NOAA Fleet Replacement and Modernization Plan described in section 891b of this title.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: For short title of this subchapter as the “NOAA Fleet Modernization Act”, see section 601 of Pub. L. 102–567, set out as a Short Title of 1992 Amendment note under section 851 of this title.
